## Core Capabilities & Services (With Plain-Language Summaries)

### 1. 3D Web Engineering & Spatial Interfaces
- **Technical Summary**: Ultra-high performance, zero-CDN, bespoke WebGL 3D interactive web experiences (living botanical tree with seasonal dynamics, procedural terrains, and hardware-accelerated shaders).
- **In Plain English for Business Owners**: An interactive, memorable 3D website that loads in under 1 second on any mobile phone or laptop with zero lag.
- **Tech Stack**: Native WebGL, GLSL Shaders, Three.js, Canvas API, Hardware Accelerated CSS, Zero External Dependency Architecture.

### 2. Generative AI & Agentic Systems (LangGraph & MCP)
- **Technical Summary**: Autonomous multi-agent workflows, self-healing tool pipelines, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server development for enterprise tool integration.
- **In Plain English for Clinic & Hotel Admins**: AI assistants that perform multi-step business tasks — checking appointment openings, syncing customer records, and guiding clients automatically.
- **Specialization**: LangGraph, LangChain, Anthropic MCP, Claude 3.5 Sonnet / GPT-4o / Gemini 1.5/2.0 API integrations, custom tool creation, human-in-the-loop validation.

### 3. Enterprise Hybrid RAG & Knowledge Graphs
- **Technical Summary**: Production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation combining semantic vector search (FAISS, Chroma, Qdrant) with structural graph databases (Neo4j) and BGE rerankers.
- **In Plain English for Corporate Teams**: Connects internal company documents, policies, and products to an AI that answers questions with 100% verified accuracy and zero hallucinations.
- **Key Advantage**: Zero-hallucination domain intelligence, complex multi-hop entity reasoning, citation verification, and enterprise document ingestion.

### 4. Business Process Automation & MLOps
- **Technical Summary**: End-to-end operational automation replacing manual bottlenecks with intelligent async workers, CRM sync, WhatsApp/Email lead automation, and ERP forecasting modules.
- **In Plain English for Operations Leads**: Automates repetitive backend work like capturing WhatsApp leads into your CRM and triggering workflows automatically.
- **Tech Stack**: FastAPI, Docker, Redis, Celery, Google Cloud Run, Azure AI, PostgreSQL, GitHub Actions CI/CD.

### 5. Time-Series Demand Forecasting & Decision AI
- **Technical Summary**: Statistical demand modeling (Croston, TSB, Exponential Smoothing, LightGBM) and Monte Carlo confidence intervals for manufacturing and retail inventory optimization.
- **In Plain English for Factory & Retail Owners**: Predicts exactly how much stock or inventory you will need next month to avoid stockouts and reduce tied-up capital.

## Flagship Systems & Case Studies (Accurate Classifications)

1. **HyreFast Intelligence Architecture** `[Case Study / Architectural Prototype]`:
   - Full-stack AI recruiting engine with LangGraph, Neo4j, FastAPI, Redis, and MCP server.
   - Normalized 12,000+ candidate skills across 40+ taxonomy dimensions with self-healing ingestion loops.
2. **Zovia Inventory Forecasting Engine** `[Manufacturing ERP Case Study]`:
   - ERP-integrated intermittent demand forecasting engine with TSB modeling, Monte Carlo simulations, and automated reorder triggers.
3. **MediFlow & Clinical MCP Assistant** `[Healthcare AI Research & Architecture Prototype]`:
   - LangGraph multi-agent clinical assistant with hybrid FAISS RAG, LangSmith observability, and authenticated MCP tool execution.
4. **Himalayan Living Tree & Mountain Engine** `[Live Core Platform]`:
   - Zero-dependency procedural 3D Himalayan WebGL engine with 8 seasonal atmospheric palettes, PBR leaf venation shaders, and 60 FPS hardware rendering.
